title: 老办法：走不出老困境，行动主义该换什么策略？
speaker: Rashad Robinson

segments.en: And so we do have to think differently because the strategies that sort of got us into this mess the sort of ways in which we are facing so many challenges they're not going to be the same challenges that get us out.
segments.zh: 所以我们必须换一种思路，因为让我们陷入困境的策略，面对诸多挑战的方式，不会成为让我们脱困的答案。

segments.en: And I think for those that have been showing up in this moment protesting raising their voices in different ways they're asking a lot of times of like why are we losing?
segments.zh: 我想对那些此刻站出来抗议、以不同方式发声的人说，他们常常问：为什么我们一直在输？

segments.en: Why haven't we won more things? And the answer accountability?
segments.zh: 为什么我们没有赢得更多？答案是问责吗？

segments.en: Well the answer is that we've just been using the wrong strategies. The answer is that we haven't had a clear analysis around where we take the fights to.
segments.zh: 答案是，我们一直在用错误的策略。我们没有清晰分析该把斗争引向何处。

segments.en: And so I think that losing and recognizing that you're losing is like the first step on the way to winning.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，失败并认识到自己正在失败，是通往胜利的第一步。

segments.en: Because I think one thing that the right wing has done really effective is they've changed politics.
segments.zh: 因为我认为右翼做得非常有效的一件事是，他们改变了政治。

segments.en: They've made it so that everyone has a role. So people wear their red caps out in the world if you go into...
segments.zh: 他们让每个人都有角色。所以人们戴着红帽子出现在世界上，如果你走进……

segments.en: Yeah they go into a gym they're changing the challenge of conservative media.
segments.zh: 是的，他们走进健身房，改变着保守派媒体的挑战。

segments.en: They're doing all sorts of things to shape the environment that they live in.
segments.zh: 他们做各种事情来塑造自己生活的环境。

segments.en: And a lot of times for folks who believe in social change and progress are almost whispering their beliefs or maybe just showing up to a protest in the most comfortable part of town.
segments.zh: 很多时候，相信社会变革和进步的人们几乎是在低声细语地表达信念，或者只是出现在城里最舒适的地方参加抗议。

segments.en: You know on the designated day where it gets wrapped up after three hours and everyone goes home but then the rest of their time they're not wearing their energy out in the world.
segments.zh: 在指定的日子，三小时后结束，大家回家，但其余时间他们并没有在世界上展现自己的能量。

segments.en: And so as a result we can sometimes look like we're almost embarrassed by what we believe.
segments.zh: 因此，有时我们看起来几乎对自己的信念感到尴尬。
